text: [calm, natural narrator voice] The whole plan on one page: thirty-six months, three axes, five steps. Hard constraints, crowd laws, thresholds and reversals, from three dials to a precessing cylinder. Three papers, at months ten, twenty-two and thirty-three, with no acceptance promised.
